capabilities.scope: Coaxial sequential refraction with Angle, Object Height, Paraxial Image Height and Real Image Height fields, explicit X/Y coordinates and field weights. Finite ENPD/object NA, per-wavelength real stop aiming for finite or infinite objects, and sampled finite-source pupil acceptance are supported. Ideal-lens geometry currently requires infinite conjugates; ideal OPD/MTF is not validated.
capabilities.optimization: Guided CPU goals include best focus, balanced image quality, wavefront, MTF, RMS spot and custom MF. Presets preserve the project's MF and can jointly explore curvatures, glass thicknesses and axial air spacings, with a final effective focal-length tolerance. The MF catalog includes point OPD and scalar FFT MTF. CPU ranking independently checks denser RMS, MTF and managed OPD profiles when supported. Standalone WFE screening provides CPU and compatible optional CUDA scope.

meritFunction.sampling: RMS operands use local area quadrature; OPDC/OPDM/OPDX use explicit MF pupil points and weights. Native sampling equivalence is not certified.

airyReference.scope: Primary-wavelength scalar first-dark-ring reference from directional image-space NA; clipped marginal rays are unavailable, not extrapolated.

automation.sessions: independent of the current GUI lens

airy.definition: First dark ring of a uniform circular-pupil scalar Airy reference: radius = 1.22 × vacuum wavelength × directional working F/# = 0.61 × vacuum wavelength / image-space NA.
airy.workingFNumberDefinition: Opposing marginal NAs are averaged separately for tangential and sagittal pupil directions at the prescribed conjugates; physical apertures remain active.
airy.scope: Diffraction size reference only; this is not a PSF or diffraction-performance acceptance result.

definitions.fieldCoordinate: Curves use signed Y when every field X is zero; otherwise their field abscissa is hypot(declared X, declared Y). Original fieldX/fieldY are retained in table rows.
definitions.method: 100 * (real chief-ray height - first-order reference height) / first-order reference height. Height is signed image Y for a Y-only field table, or projection onto the reference radial image direction for X/Y fields.
definitions.reference: Primary-wavelength Gaussian angular image scale times actual incident slopes for an infinite object, or Gaussian transverse magnification times resolved physical object X/Y for a finite object. Image-height fields are first converted to their physical launch, so they do not force reported distortion to zero. All real chiefs are evaluated at the current flat image plane.
definitions.axis: Distortion at zero reference height is undefined and is returned as null. Off-primary curves include lateral color relative to the primary reference.

warnings: The current image plane differs from the primary Gaussian focus; distortion uses actual chief heights at the current plane.

processAudit.limit_precedence: Lens entries override defaults for that lens. Shared faces use the tightest effective slope/margin; air and rim requirements apply to both adjacent ambient interfaces and use the tightest complete (minimum + budget) requirement from either bordering lens. Bonded shared faces have no air/rim gap requirement.
